newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel sentences Hamas man to life imprisonment.
newsitem.headline: Israel sentences Hamas man to life imprisonment.

text.p: An Israeli military court on Thursday sentenced a top Islamic guerrilla to life imprisonment after convicting him of killing a Palestinian suspected of cooperating with Israel and planning a Gaza suicide attack.

An army spokeswoman said Hassan Salameh, a member of the militant Hamas group, was convicted in a military court in Gaza on 31 charges which also included weapons offences and membership in an organisation hostile to Israel.
Israeli authorities arrested Salameh a year ago after a wave of Palestinian suicide bombings killed 59 people in the Jewish state.

The spokeswoman said the court found Salameh guilty of killing a Palestinian who he believed was "collaborating" with Israel and planning a suicide bombing in which an Israeli soldier was wounded in the Gaza Strip in 1995.
He was sentenced to two life terms plus another 15 years imprisonment, to run consecutively.

Separate proceedings against Salameh are under way in an Israeli military court in the West Bank where he has pleaded guilty to 46 counts of murder resulting from two bus bombings in Jerusalem last year.
